transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the courtyard set design review. We have two options on the table — a masonry courtyard set or a modular painted-timber courtyard set — and our approved construction budget is $180,000. Before I can authorize fabrication to begin, I need to hear from each of our representatives: structural, permit, stunt, and insurance. So let's go around the room. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share my structural findings from yesterday's load test. The masonry courtyard option would exceed Soundstage 3's floor limit of 600 kilograms per square meter, so that design is not viable as-is. The modular painted-timber design does pass, but only if we install a 30-millimeter load-spreading deck. I should note my written report is still in the engineering queue and hasn't been formally distributed yet.
